claims.text: DIA-08-1004-004 states that its product 'is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency, Defense Warning Office's Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program', with questions to be addressed to James T. Lacatski, D.Eng., AAWSA Program Manager, ATTN: CLAR/DWO-3, Bldg 6000, Washington DC 20340-5100.
DIA-08-1004-004 gives the author's address as EarthTech International, Inc., 11855 Research Blvd, Austin, TX 78759.

Davis, Ph.D., of EarthTech International Inc. as author and states it was produced in FY2009 under the DIA Defense Warning Office's Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications programme, with James T. DIRD DIA-08-1004-004, 'Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy', was authored by Eric W. Davis of EarthTech International and dated 6 April 2010.
